headline: First Thing: Three young children killed in Oregon elementary school shooting

members.title: First Thing: Three young children killed in Oregon elementary school shooting
Police search for clues to deadly shooting at Oregon elementary school
members.lead: Schools closed after one teacher and three children killed, and child and teacher hospitalized with critical injuries Oregon elementary school shooting: what we know so far Police are investigating a deadly shooting at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon, where a 16-year-old opened fire on Thursday, killing three children and a teacher, before being shot dead by an armed bystander. Authorities in Oregon said that the three children killed at Silver Rail elementary school were aged five, eight and 11, and that a seven-year-old child and a 54-year-old teacher were also hospitalized with critical injuries.
